'''Ryan Yee''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[July 2000 Vancouver tournament]] on 1 July 2000 with [[Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|Raltir Ops]], according to Ryan Mathison's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d954">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-01-vancouver-bc-canada-1-7-00d954/ vancouver-bc-canada-1-7-00], DeckTech (Ryan "Cradossk" Mathison, 1 July 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-01-vancouver-bc-canada-1-7-00d954/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
